title: Sparse entropic quadrature for moment equations
summary: In the present work, we study the properties of the sparse entropic quadrature method, a recently proposed method for the closure of systems of moment equations in rarefied gas dynamics. We prove the properties of the method regarding its well-posedness, hyperbolicity, and stability for first-order spatial convection schemes.
